applicant.name: Dr. Sophie Lechner
applicant.organisation: Danube Institute for Diabetes Research (university research group)

purpose: Follow-up to our earlier request: we study regional differences in type 2 diabetes among adults aged 19 and over to plan a prevention programme with the regional health authorities.
question: How many adults aged 19 or older have type 2 diabetes in each region and what is the prevalence?
definitions: Adult = aged 19 or older on 31 December 2025.
Type 2 diabetes = any condition with an ICD-10 code starting with E11.
Prevalence = adults with type 2 diabetes / all adults in the region × 100, one decimal.
Report per region: adults, adults with type 2 diabetes and the prevalence.
